facts.text: B12 + Oat Extract 6.5% Gentle Cleanser
Gentle, low-foaming cleanser for damaged, sensitive skin
A super mild, gel cream cleanser that removes dirt & excess sebum without damaging barrier function. Oat based mild cleansing agent for soothing & calming irritated & sensitised skin.
"For people with sensitive and acne prone skin can use this after using a salicylic face wash as it will not strip off moisture from face -Menakha P."
A mild, daily creamy gel cleanser that gently washes away impurities without drying skin.
Oat-based mild surfactant (cleansing agent) creates a low and cushiony lather that effectively dissolves dirt & oil without compromising the skin barrier.
Formulated with effective hydrators like Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin B5, and Glycerin to keep skin hydrated and supple even after cleansing.
Vitamin B12, known for its skin-restoring properties, works alongside Oat Extract to soothe damaged or irritated skin — making this cleanser suitable even for very dry, dehydrated and sensitive skin.
Skin type: Dry/Normal, Sensitive, Oily/Combination, Acne-Prone
Concerns: Dry, Dehydrated & Sensitive Skin
Suitable for: 15+ years of age
Pregnancy/Lactation: Safe

Apply on wet skin & massage cleanser in a gentle, circular motion. Rinse-off thoroughly. This is a gentle cleanser & produces very little foam yet provides sufficient cleansing without making skin dry.
When to use: AM & PM. Everyday
A powerful & well proven anti-inflammatory ingredient that relieves skin discomfort and alleviates skin redness, & tightness

Vitamin B12, also known as Cyanocobalamin, helps soothe irritated and sensitive skin by calming inflammation, reducing redness, and supporting skin barrier repair. It breaks the cycle of flare-ups, offering real relief and comfort.
Provides deep penetrating moisture to the skin and has anti-inflammatory effects

Water/Aqua, Glycerin, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Butylene Glycol, Sodium Lauroyl Oat Amino Acid, Cetyl Alcohol, Stearyl Alcohol, Methyl Gluceth-20, Cocoglucoside, Panthenol, Glyceryl Oleate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Cyanocobalamin, Pentylene Glycol, Lactic Acid, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium Cocyl Isethionate, Polyacrylate Crosspolymer-6, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate

facts.section: Can this cleanser be used for sensitive / irritated skin?
facts.text: Yes. We have formulated this cleanser, especially for dry / dehydrated / sensitive skin types. It's a very gentle, low-foaming, gel cream-based cleanser that contains a low concentration of a very mild cleansing agent. It leaves skin soft & hydrated without any residual feel

facts.section: Can this cleanser be used on active acne?
facts.text: Yes. This cleanser emulsifies excess sebum without drying skin out. Dehydrated skin may trigger excess oil production which can further worsen acne / breakouts. A gentle, non-dehydrating cleanser can calm skin down

facts.section: Can it be used to remove makeup?
facts.text: The combination of emulsifiers & surfactants in the formula can emulsify makeup & sunscreen. However, you might need to double cleanse if your makeup or sunscreen is heavy on silicones & waxes
